theorems.name: cm_preservation_reachable
theorems.statement:
Theorem cm_preservation_reachable sp ap nilslot p input n :
 cm_semantic_wf_program(cm_source_function_policy sp)p ->cm_task_succeeds sp(CMStartTask p input) ->
 cm_preservation_invariant sp ap nilslot p(cm_annotated_iter sp ap n(cm_annotated_start(cm_source_function_policy sp)p input)).

theorems.name: cmc_preservation
theorems.statement:
Theorem cmc_preservation sp p input output status :
 cm_semantic_wf_program(cm_source_function_policy sp)p ->cm_source_terminates sp p input output status ->
 tvm_terminates(cm_compile_model(cm_source_function_policy sp)p)input output status.

theorems.name: cmc_compile_success_bridge
theorems.statement:
Theorem cmc_compile_success_bridge sp p obj input output status :
 cm_semantic_wf_program(cm_source_function_policy sp)p ->cm_source_terminates sp p input output status ->
 cm_output_decodes 0(cm_rep_ops(cm_model_code(cm_source_function_policy sp)p))(cm_rep_imms(cm_model_code(cm_source_function_policy sp)p))(cm_model_data_bytes p)obj ->
 tvm_terminates obj input output status.

review: Preservation still assumes semantic well-formedness and successful source termination and concludes target termination with the identical input, output trace and exit status.
Success bridge additionally assumes the original model opcode/immediate/data decoding relation, then concludes the same TVM observation for that decoded object.

The original eighteen-conjunct invariant is reconstructed and proved for every annotated state reached along a successful source run. Induction uses a stronger internal support invariant. No extra internal invariant is an input premise of preservation or the success bridge.
This does not claim a name-for-name port of every C* support export, or a separate arbitrary-state theorem for the original weak eighteen-conjunct step premise.
No divergence preservation, bidirectional equivalence or concrete TVM interpreter implementation guarantee is claimed.
